input: Repot all succulents on the kitchen shelf

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing exactly how many succulents and whether any are excluded (e.g., recently repotted ones) determines the scale of the job and how much prep is needed.
Whether the user already has pots, soil, and tools on hand — or needs to buy them — changes whether shopping is a prerequisite step.
A specific target date or deadline affects how urgently to schedule the task and whether it needs to be split across sessions.
Knowing if this is a solo task or involves others (e.g., a partner, child helping) affects how steps are assigned and sequenced.
Whether the user wants to match pots aesthetically, upgrade to a uniform look, or simply use whatever is available changes the shopping and planning steps.
Understanding what 'done well' means — just moved into new pots, or also cleaned, pruned, refreshed with new soil, and tidied — defines the true scope of work.
Knowing where the user is in the process (has supplies, has pots picked out, etc.) determines what the very first actionable step should be.

gold.taskTitle: Repot all succulents on the kitchen shelf
gold.taskDescription: Repot every succulent currently sitting on the kitchen shelf into new or larger containers.

questions.title: How many succulents are you repotting?
questions.description: The total count of succulents on the kitchen shelf that need to be repotted, including any you might skip.

questions.title: Do you already have pots and soil ready?
questions.description: Whether the necessary supplies — pots, succulent soil mix, drainage materials — are already on hand or still need to be purchased.

questions.title: When do you want this finished by?
questions.description: The target date or timeframe the user has in mind for completing the repotting task.

questions.title: Will you be doing this alone or with help?
questions.description: Whether the task is a solo effort or if another person will be involved, which affects how steps are divided.

questions.title: Do the new pots need to match a specific look?
questions.description: Whether the user has aesthetic preferences — uniform style, specific colours, or materials — for the replacement pots.

questions.title: Should this include pruning or cleaning each plant?
questions.description: Whether 'repotting' means just transferring plants, or also involves removing dead leaves, trimming roots, and refreshing the soil fully.

questions.title: Where will you do the repotting — indoors or outside?
questions.description: The physical workspace planned for the task, which affects prep needed for mess containment and tool access.
